name: Deformable Registration
description: Non-rigid point cloud alignment using Coherent Point Drift (CPD) and Gaussian deformation fields. Handles elastic deformations between shapes.

theory.overview:
Deformable registration finds a non-rigid transformation that aligns a source shape to a target. CPD models source points as GMM centroids and fits them via EM optimization.

The displacement function is:
$$\mathbf{v}(\mathbf{x}) = \sum_{m=1}^{M} w_m \phi(\|\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{y}_m\|)$$
where $\phi$ is a Gaussian kernel and $w_m$ are optimized coefficients.

cpd_deformable.title: Coherent Point Drift
cpd_deformable.content:
CPD treats alignment as probability density estimation. The E-step computes correspondence probabilities, the M-step updates the transformation with regularization:
$$E(W) = \frac{1}{2\sigma^2} \sum_n \|T(y_n) - x_n\|^2 + \frac{\lambda}{2} \text{tr}(W^T G W)$$

gaussian_deformation.title: Gaussian Pressure Deformation
gaussian_deformation.content:
A localized Gaussian deformation, continuous at the radius $r$:
$$\mathbf{d}(\mathbf{p}) = d_{\max} \cdot  rac{g(\|\mathbf{p} - \mathbf{c}\|) - g(r)}{1 - g(r)} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{n}}, \quad g(d) = \exp\left(- rac{d^2}{2\sigma^2}ight), \quad \|\mathbf{p} - \mathbf{c}\| < r$$
and 0 beyond $r$.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: Convergence tolerance (passed to pycpd as tolerance).

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: CPD Gaussian-kernel width (smoothness), in units of the RMS radius of the two clouds.

parameters.name: low_rank
parameters.description: Not supported by pycpd 2 (it ignored it silently): true is refused.

parameters.name: num_eig
parameters.description: Ignored: only meaningful with low_rank, which pycpd 2 does not support.

parameters.name: displacement
parameters.description: Maximum displacement at the pressure centre, in file units (required).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of influence, in file units (required); no point within it is an error.

parameters.name: sigma_factor
parameters.description: Gaussian falloff sigma as a fraction of radius.
